audience.primary: Teams that already use AI tools but still do repetitive work by hand

problem.headline: Your team has AI tools. So why are they still doing everything themselves?

points.name: AI tools are in place
points.description: Companies have invested in ChatGPT, Copilot, and other AI tools.

points.name: The work is still manual
points.description: Employees still spend hours preparing for meetings, putting together reports, and moving information between apps.

problem.closing: AI is available. Getting value from it still takes work.

solution.headline: What if AI took the first step?

steps.name: Today
steps.description: Employees figure out what needs to be done, open an AI tool, provide context, and check the output.

steps.name: With Jin
steps.description: Jin recognizes what's coming up, prepares a first draft, and lets employees review it when they're ready.

solution.closing: Instead of asking AI for help, your team starts with work that's already prepared.

how_it_works.introduction: Connect once, see every part, and Jin AI keeps each team's shared harness up to date.

features.name: Connect once
features.description: Connect your usual AI tools once, through MCP.

features.name: See every part by type
features.description: Skills, prompts, memory and MCP settings, sorted by type.

features.name: See what each team uses most
features.description: See which harnesses each department uses most.

features.name: Separate personal from company
features.description: Keep what came from personal AI apart from parts that hold confidential company context.

features.name: Control approved AI tools
features.description: Let people use only the tools you approve. For example: Claude Code for developers only, your company policy in Copilot, and only non-confidential parts in ChatGPT.

data_principles.headline: Jin does the prep work. Your team stays in control
data_principles.introduction: Jin reads the email, calendar, chat, and files your team connects, such as Gmail, Outlook, Slack, and Teams, so the work it prepares is accurate. What it reads is used only to prepare work for that person. It is never used to train AI models, and your admin can exclude any folder, channel, label, or team.
items: Your admin chooses which teams and tools Jin can use. Each employee connects their own account and can disconnect at any time.
Jin never sends messages or changes your systems without approval.
What Jin finds goes to the employee, not their manager. Jin does not score or rank people.
Each company's data is kept separate. Jin never records your screen.
data_principles.closing: Helpful by default. Always under your control.

direct_answers.question: What is Jin AI?
direct_answers.answer: Jin spots repetitive tasks, prepares the work, and learns from your team's feedback.

direct_answers.question: What is an AI harness?
direct_answers.answer: An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.

direct_answers.question: Is Jin AI available now?
direct_answers.answer: Jin AI is in private beta. We are working through the waitlist.

direct_answers.question: Which AI tools does it work with?
direct_answers.answer: Claude Code first. Other AI tools are next.

direct_answers.question: Where does the data live?
direct_answers.answer: Jin AI keeps each company's data separate. What Jin reads is used only to prepare work for that person and is never used to train AI models.

direct_answers.question: How is this different from banning AI tools?
direct_answers.answer: Banning AI tools also removes the harnesses that work. Jin AI keeps confidential data in and lets the company reuse what works.
